name: marquee
description: An AI movie concierge: a TMDB MCP server, a Claude agent that uses it, and a React app to browse, track, and ask for movies.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @marquee/tmdb-mcp && npm run build -w @marquee/api && npm run build -w @marquee/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @marquee/tmdb-mcp && npm run dev -w @marquee/api & npm run dev -w @marquee/web
scripts.eval: npm run build -w @marquee/tmdb-mcp && npm run eval -w @marquee/api --
